text: Sentinel's analytics rules aren't the only detection layer Oakmere is building. This lesson architects ip-reputation-enrichment.py -- a Python script running as a scheduled Azure Automation Runbook.
Once a day, it pulls sign-in logs and cross-references every source IP against a threat-intelligence reputation feed -- a completely different method than any Sentinel rule uses.
A match doesn't just log quietly. It opens a real ticket in the SOC's queue, with the flagged account and IP attached, so someone actually has to act on it.
The design choice that matters most: this runs independent of Sentinel's own rule logic, on purpose, so a blind spot in one detection method isn't automatically a blind spot in both.
It's also only daily, not real-time -- a deliberate tradeoff this plan states honestly. Next: finally standing up the Sentinel workspace itself.
